subject: general
question: Name the facility available for sale and purchase of goods through internet and fax.
solution:
The correct answer is __**E- Commerce**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **E-Commerce:-**

 
 
• **It is a facility available for sale and purchase of goods through internet and fax is E-Commerce.**
 
• It includes a wide range of activities, such as online shopping, online auctions, and electronic data interchange. 
 
• **E-Commerce is a convenient and efficient way to buy and sell goods. **
 
• It allows buyers to browse and compare products from a wide range of sellers, and it allows sellers to reach a global audience.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Television**:-

 
 
• It is a mode of entertainment.
 
 
 
• **Postal Service:-**
 
 
• It is a government agency or private company that provides mail services to the public. 
 
 
 
• **Telephone Service**
 
 
• it is a mode of communication.
